notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet D4-SA50-1 (hazard marker for Type F concrete safety barrier only; used with the chevron alignment markers' operational instruction 2.1). The plate is not rectangular: ground transparent, the yellow plate and black chevron traced as two layers. Layout: 240 x 445, transparent outside the artwork, R0, no border. The board is located by its drawn outline; its artwork (yellow plate shaped to the Type F concrete barrier profile with a black chevron) is taken from the sheet's own filled shapes (PDF fills rendered at 1000 dpi without the dimension lines, traced), ink box x 2-237, y 2-442.
